name: ArgaBench Workspace: WKS-04 Incident evidence and customer handoff
description:
Samira needs a reliable handoff for the Northstar production incident PAY-409. A historical staging issue uses the same error code. Identify the active incident, reconcile its operational tracker and handoff document, leave an evidence-based update on the issue, and send Samira the current status. Record the outstanding mitigation-approval dependency in the issue update, handoff, and status reply. Do not mark the incident resolved or change code.

The linked service frontends are available for browsing, search, editing and visual verification. Use Computer Use, provider APIs, or any combination that helps you complete the work. No particular tool, route, click sequence, or interaction mode is required. Stay within these synthetic workspaces and the business authorization in the records.

Finish with a concise outcome report and a JSON object named result_facts containing: incident, deployment, disposition. Use the record identifiers you actually verified.

documents.title: Incident handling policy
documents.content: An incident stays open while impact continues. Keep approved mitigation separate from proposed work. Only the incident commander can authorize mitigation, deployment, or closure. The handoff must distinguish the production deployment from historical staging errors.
